Original User Story: As a Public User, I want to Search for Information, so that I can obtain publicly available information concerning properties, County services, processes and other general information.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a Public User, I want to efficiently search for information regarding properties, county services, processes, and other general inquiries so that I can easily access relevant and publicly available data to make informed decisions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search functionality must return results within 3 seconds for at least 95% of queries.
- Users should be able to filter search results by category (e.g., properties, services, processes) with at least 80% accuracy in relevance.
- The system should provide at least 10 relevant results for each search query to ensure comprehensive information access.

Test Outline:
- Measure the response time of the search function to confirm it meets the 3-second requirement for 95% of searches.
- Conduct user testing to evaluate the accuracy of the filtering options and ensure they meet the 80% relevance threshold.
- Perform multiple search queries to verify that at least 10 relevant results are consistently returned for each query.

Original User Story: As an Applicant, I want to Submit Application, so that I can provide my information, plans and/or documents to initiate a transaction with the County.
